business_problem: Slack needed to turn huge volumes of messages, threads, and files into searchable, permission-aware knowledge and time-saving summaries without sacrificing security or conversational quality.
solution_summary: Slack uses the Claude Platform as a core model layer for several AI features that sit directly inside the collaboration product. Natural-language search runs across conversations, threads, and files to surface relevant content quickly, while instant summaries and AI-generated recaps condense channels, highlight action items, and prioritize unread discussions. Claude's long context window and conversational quality let Slack personalize tone and format instead of returning generic answers, and the implementation respects existing content and channel permissions for enterprise customers. Slack also uses Claude Code plus close model-testing collaboration with Anthropic to accelerate prototyping and engineering work behind the product. The result is an AI layer that treats the message archive as organizational knowledge rather than just chat history and makes that knowledge available in the same interface where teams already work.
